summary: A–D,F,H confirmed by independent arithmetic and producer re-runs. E: adopted magnets agree at 83.8°C exactly; continuous_reference magnets differ by 0.115 K (strictly >0.1 K). G: duty required is 125.2193 N·m; 119.7 is shaft torque at 244.49 kW — ABD/EM/ISO/bevel/mount do not flatter, but gear_oil required_shaft_torque_nm=119.73 and workbook never surfaces 125.2. Iron loss correctly labelled screening_estimate (two-sided), not upper bound. ship_ok remains false.

findings.claim: A) Torque required 125.2193 N·m from T=P_elec/(η·ω), η≈0.9777
findings.observed: claimed=125.2193; independent η=0.9777 → 125.219269 N·m (gap −3e-5); FE analytical η=0.977734 → 125.214912 N·m (gap −0.0044). Formula: T_shaft=P_elec/(η_combined·ω) with ω=n·2π/60. Match.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Required regen/duty shaft torque at 250 kW / 19500 rpm is ~125.22 N·m using combined η≈0.9777.

findings.claim: B) Delivered baseline ~81.558 N·m; DEC-009 24k rpm/130mm → ~1.069×
findings.command: python scripts/lib/dec_em1_option_screen.py --twin <twin>; read FE mean and combined row rpm=24000 stack=130
findings.observed: claimed baseline≈81.558 / ratio≈1.069; observed mean |T|=81.558081; 24k/130 torque_ratio=1.069 (combined ratio=1.0692=implied_delivered 108.782 / required 101.741). Producer re-run reproduces 1.069. Note ratio is vs speed-adjusted required torque, not 81.558×1.069.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Baseline FE mean torque is ~81.6 N·m (~0.65× required); 24k/130 option is the first that clears torque at ~1.069× its own required.

findings.claim: C) Iron loss 6035 W screening_estimate range 3.9–8.5 kW — confirm basis label; flag if called upper bound
findings.command: Steinmetz recompute kh·f·B^α+ke·f²·B² on tooth/yoke masses; 0.65×–1.4× envelope
findings.observed: claimed 6035 W / screening_estimate / 3.9–8.5 kW; observed iron_loss_w=6035.1, basis=screening_estimate, tooth 2249.4 + yoke 3785.7. Caveat: 'SCREENING ESTIMATE, not a bound… TWO-SIDED' → 3.92–8.45 kW (corners 3.92–8.45). NOT labelled upper bound in primary artefacts.
findings.reader_would_conclude: 6035 W is a mid screening point with a two-sided uncertainty band ~3.9–8.5 kW, not a conservative upper bound.
